def capture_backup(plan,auth,transport,root):
    authorize(plan,auth,'BACKUP_READ_EXPORT')
    if plan.fixture != transport.fixture or transport.identity != auth['targetIdentity']:raise Failure('TARGET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
    if not plan.fixture and Path(root)!=Path(transport.profile['backupRoot']):raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','BACKUP_ROOT')
    root=private_directory(root)
    directory=private_directory(root/('exact-single-'+uuid.uuid4().hex))
    metadata=private_directory(directory/'metadata')
    started=time.time()
    attempt=uuid.uuid4().hex
    if getattr(transport,'_backup_attempt',None):raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','BACKUP_ALREADY_ACTIVE')
    transport._backup_attempt=attempt
    proofs={}
    context={'captureId':attempt,'sourceTargetId':sha(canonical(transport.identity)),
             'targetProfile':plan.data['targetProfile'],'sourceIdentitySha256':sha(canonical(transport.identity)),
             'authorizationSha256':sha(canonical(auth)),'operationalPackageDigest':sha(canonical(auth['packageHashes']))}
    diagnostic=None
    local_finished=False
    try:
        diagnostic_root = root.parent / 'backup-diagnostics' if plan.fixture else ROOT / transport.profile['receiptRoot'] / 'backup-diagnostics'
        diagnostic=_LocalBackupDiagnostics(diagnostic_root, attempt, plan, auth)
        with transport._session(True) as s:
            proofs['exporter']=s._transport_proof
            before=observe(s)
            if fingerprint(before)!=auth['catalogBeforeSha256'] or before['prefix']!=plan.data['ledger']['sourcePrefixSha256']:
                raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','BACKUP_BASELINE')
            counts=_counts(s)
            snap=s._json('select to_jsonb(pg_export_snapshot());')
            if not re.fullmatch('[0-9A-F]+-[0-9A-F]+-[0-9]+',snap):raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','SNAPSHOT_ID')
            full=transport._tool('pg_dump',['-d','postgres','-Fc','--snapshot='+snap])
            proofs['full']=transport._take_tool_proof('pg_dump',full)
            schema=transport._tool('pg_dump',['-d','postgres','-Fc','--schema-only','--snapshot='+snap])
            proofs['schema']=transport._take_tool_proof('pg_dump',schema)
            _source_collision(before)
            before_values,before_queries=_measure_prerequisites(s,'PRE',proofs['exporter'])
            pre=_measure_bootstrap(s,'PRE',proofs['exporter'],context)
            _require(pre['canonicalResponse']['session_user'] == transport.identity['role'] and
                     pre['canonicalResponse']['current_user'] == transport.identity['currentRole'],
                     'SOURCE_BOOTSTRAP_CAPTURE_BINDING_MISMATCH')
            roles=transport._tool('pg_dumpall',['--roles-only','--no-role-passwords'])
            proofs['roles']=transport._take_tool_proof('pg_dumpall',roles)
            # Exporter must still be alive, and all same-snapshot contracts must match.
            if observe(s)!=before:raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','EXPORTER_DRIFT')
            s._rollback()
        with transport._session(True) as s:
            proofs['afterObservation']=s._transport_proof
            post=_measure_bootstrap(s,'POST',proofs['afterObservation'],context)
            after_values,after_queries=_measure_prerequisites(s,'POST',proofs['afterObservation'])
            after=observe(s);s._rollback()
        provenance=_build_provenance(pre,post,before_values,after_values,before_queries+after_queries,before,roles,proofs,context)
        if after!=before:raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','SOURCE_OR_ROLE_DRIFT')
        bundle={'contract':'backup-transport-proofs/1','backupAttempt':attempt,
                'snapshot':snap,'records':{k:{'proof':_read_proof(v),'sha256':v['sha256']} for k,v in proofs.items()}}
        _validate_proofs(bundle,plan,auth,transport,started,time.time(),
                         {'full':sha(full),'schema':sha(schema),'roles':sha(roles)})
        _validate_provenance(provenance,before,roles,bundle,authorization_sha=sha(canonical(auth)),
                             package_digest=sha(canonical(auth['packageHashes'])))
        if not full.startswith(b'PGDMP') or not schema.startswith(b'PGDMP'):raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','ARCHIVE_FORMAT')
        # Validate both actual archive TOCs with pinned owned tool image.
        with diagnostic.active():
            for phase,kind,raw in [('C','ARCHIVE_FULL_TOC_LIST',full),('D','ARCHIVE_SCHEMA_TOC_LIST',schema)]:
                with _diagnostic_phase(phase), _diagnostic_operation(kind):
                    _docker(['run','--rm','-i','--pull=never','--network','none','--entrypoint','pg_restore',IMAGE_ID,'--list'],raw)
            restore=_restore(full,roles,before,counts,provenance,bundle)
        diagnostic.finish()
        local_finished=True
        for name,raw in [('database.dump',full),('schema.dump',schema),('roles.sql',roles)]:_write_bytes(directory/name,raw)
        exclusive(metadata/'catalog.json',before,redact=False)
        exclusive(metadata/'counts.json',counts,redact=False)
        exclusive(metadata/'migration-ledger.json',before['ledger'],redact=False)
        exclusive(metadata/'bootstrap-provenance.json',provenance,redact=False)
        exclusive(metadata/'restore.json',restore,redact=False)
        # A portable, hash-bound copy of each immutable invocation sidecar. No
        # proof is borrowed from a different client or from an earlier backup.
        bundle={'contract':'backup-transport-proofs/1','backupAttempt':attempt,
                'snapshot':snap,'records':{k:{'proof':_read_proof(v),'sha256':v['sha256']} for k,v in proofs.items()}}
        _validate_proofs(bundle,plan,auth,transport,started,time.time(),
                         {'full':sha(full),'schema':sha(schema),'roles':sha(roles)})
        exclusive(metadata/'transport-proofs.json',bundle)
        files={str(p.relative_to(directory)):{'sha256':sha(safe_file(p,True)),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        manifest={'reportVersion':MANIFEST_VERSION,'status':'VALID','planId':plan.data['planId'],
                  'backupAttempt':attempt,'snapshot':snap,
                  'transportContract':'OWNED_ISOLATED_FIXTURE' if plan.fixture else TRANSPORT_CONTRACT,
                  'riskAcceptance':None if plan.fixture else RISK_BINDING.copy(),
                  'planSha256':plan.digest,'targetProfile':plan.data['targetProfile'],'sourceIdentitySha256':sha(canonical(transport.identity)),
                  'snapshotStart':started,'snapshotEnd':time.time(),'sealedAt':time.time(),
                  'ledgerCount':len(before['ledger']),'ledgerLatest':before['ledger'][-1]['version'],
                  'ledgerSha256':before['prefix'],'fullSourcePrefixDigest':before['prefix'],
                  'catalogSha256':fingerprint(before),'packageHashes':auth['packageHashes'],'files':files,
                  'rolesCapture':'SEPARATE_NON_MVCC_CAPTURE_BEFORE_AFTER_FINGERPRINT_MATCH',
                  'restoreStatus':'PASS','offHostCopy':'NOT_CLAIMED','retention':'7_DAYS_AND_THROUGH_STABLE_STAGE1G'}
        manifest.update(recoveryCandidateName=RECOVERY_CANDIDATE,recoveryCandidateVersion=RECOVERY_VERSION,
                        recoveryReportContract=RESTORE_CONTRACT,rawRolesSha256=sha(roles),
                        sourceBootstrapProvenance=dict(path=PROVENANCE_PATH,contract=PROVENANCE_CONTRACT,**files[PROVENANCE_PATH]))
        _require(set(files)==REQUIRED_FILES)
        authorize(plan,auth,'BACKUP_READ_EXPORT')
        exclusive(metadata/'manifest.json',manifest)
        _write_bytes(directory/'SHA256SUMS', ''.join(v['sha256']+'  '+k+'\n' for k,v in sorted(files.items())).encode())
        return directory
    except Exception as e:
        wrapped_primary = e.primary if isinstance(e,_DiagnosticPersistenceError) else None
        if wrapped_primary is not None:e=wrapped_primary
        if diagnostic is not None and not local_finished:diagnostic.finish(e)
        if isinstance(e,_DiagnosticPersistenceError):e=Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','DIAGNOSTIC_PERSISTENCE_FAILED')
        try:exclusive(directory/'FAILED.json',{'status':'INVALID','code':e.code if isinstance(e,Failure) else 'CAPTURE_FAILED'})
        except Exception:pass
        if isinstance(e,Failure):
            if wrapped_primary is not None or e.code=='DIAGNOSTIC_PERSISTENCE_FAILED':raise e from None
            raise
        raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED','CAPTURE_FAILED') from None
    finally:
        transport._backup_attempt=None

def begin(self, kind, container):
        if kind not in _DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES.get(self.phase, set()):
            raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED', 'DIAGNOSTIC_OPERATION_INVALID')
        if container is not None and not re.fullmatch('uply-runner-i1-[a-f0-9]{32}', container):
            raise Failure('BACKUP_FAILED', 'DIAGNOSTIC_OPERATION_INVALID')
        record = dict(contract='backup-docker-invocation/1', recordType='START',
            backupAttempt=self.attempt, sequenceNumber=self.sequence+1, phase=self.phase,
            operationKind=kind, startedAt=time.time(), completedAt=None, returnCode=None,
            stdoutSha256=None, stderrSha256=None, stdoutComplete=False, stderrComplete=False,
            timeout=False, containerIdentitySafeHash=sha(container.encode()) if container else None,
            imageId=IMAGE_ID, networkClassification='OWNED_NETWORK_NONE', failureCode=None,
            sanitizedErrorClass='NONE')
        self.event('docker-start', record)
        return record

def _restore(full,roles,expected,counts,provenance,bundle):
    source_identity = _validate_provenance(provenance,expected,roles,bundle)
    provenance_sha = sha(canonical(provenance)+b'\n')
    extension_expected = provenance['sourceRestorePrerequisites']['extensionRecoveryExpectedState']
    branch = _extension_prerequisite(extension_expected,expected,source_identity)
    database_plan = _database_acl_plan(provenance['sourceRestorePrerequisites']['databaseAclBeforeCapture'],
                                       source_identity,expected['roles'],provenance_sha,sha(full))
    with OwnedRestoreDestinationCluster(source_identity,provenance['serverEncoding']) as cluster:
        t = cluster.transport
        with _diagnostic_phase('E3'):
            derived, derivation = _derive_roles(roles,source_identity,cluster.bootstrap_identity)
            derivation.update(sourceBootstrapProvenanceSha256=provenance_sha,
                              destinationIdentitySha256=sha(canonical(cluster.bootstrap_identity)))
            actual_stdin_sha = sha(derived)
            _require(actual_stdin_sha == derivation['derivedSha256'], 'ROLE_STDIN_SHA_MISMATCH')
            t._sql(derived,'OWNED_ROLES_SQL')
            derivation['actualStdinSha256'] = actual_stdin_sha
            post_e3 = _role_gate(t._json(ROLE_STATE_SQL,'OWNED_ROLE_STATE'),expected)
            stage = _staged_plpgsql(t,expected,provenance['sourceRestorePrerequisites'])
            _require(canonical(stage['databaseBefore']) == canonical(stage['databaseAfter']) == canonical(database_plan['baseline']),
                     'DESTINATION_DATABASE_ACL_BASELINE_MISMATCH')
        with _diagnostic_phase('E4'), _diagnostic_operation('OWNED_PG_RESTORE',cluster.name):
            restore_argv = _restore_argv(cluster.name,branch,source_identity)
            _docker(restore_argv,full,300)
            execution_context = _restore_execution_context(restore_argv,full,branch,source_identity)
        with _diagnostic_phase('E5'):
            with t._session(True) as session:
                restored=observe(session)
                extension_e5=_read_json(session,EXTENSION_SQL)
                session._rollback()
            _extension_compare(extension_expected['extensionState'],extension_e5,expected,source_identity)
        supplement = _acl_supplement(expected,restored)
        with _diagnostic_phase('E6',required=bool(supplement)):
            if supplement: t._sql('\n'.join(supplement).encode(),'OWNED_SUPPLEMENT_SQL')
        with _diagnostic_phase('E6_DB_ACL'):
            database_execution = _database_acl_replay(t,database_plan)
        with _diagnostic_phase('E7'):
            with t._session(True) as session:
                restored=observe(session);rc=_counts(session)
                extension_e7=_read_json(session,EXTENSION_SQL)
                database_final=_database_acl_shape(_read_json(session,DATABASE_ACL_SQL))
                session._rollback()
            ext = _plpgsql_profile(t._json(PLPGSQL_SQL,'OWNED_STAGED_PLPGSQL_STATE'))
            refs = t._json(FOOTPRINT_SQL,'OWNED_FOOTPRINT')
            _unsupported_families(t._json(UNSUPPORTED_ROLE_FAMILIES_SQL,'OWNED_ROLE_STATE'))
        with _diagnostic_phase('E8'):
            normalized = _without_admin(restored,refs)
            _require(canonical(normalized) == canonical(expected) and canonical(rc) == canonical(counts) and
                     canonical(ext) == canonical(stage['extensionExpected']),
                     'RESTORE_CATALOG_OR_COUNTS_MISMATCH')
            final_role_hash = _role_gate(restored,expected)
            extension_report = _extension_report(extension_expected,extension_e5,extension_e7,expected,source_identity,refs)
            database_report = _database_acl_report(database_plan,database_execution,database_final)
            result = {'contract':RESTORE_CONTRACT,'recoveryContractVersion':RECOVERY_VERSION,
                'recoveryCandidateName':RECOVERY_CANDIDATE,'status':'PASS',
                'sourceBootstrapProvenanceSha256':provenance_sha,
                'sourceBootstrapIdentitySha256':sha(canonical(source_identity)),
                'destinationBootstrapIdentitySha256':sha(canonical(cluster.bootstrap_identity)),
                'restoreTransportIdentitySha256':sha(canonical(cluster.transport_identity)),
                'sourceBootstrapIdentity':source_identity,'destinationBootstrapIdentity':cluster.bootstrap_identity,
                'restoreTransportIdentity':cluster.transport_identity,'transportTuple':list(OWNED_RESTORE_ADMIN_TUPLE),
                'rolesDerivationReceipt':derivation,'postE3RoleFamilySha256':post_e3,
                'postFinalizationRoleFamilySha256':stage['roleFamilySha256'],
                'finalRoleFamilySha256':final_role_hash,'stagedPlpgsqlValidation':stage,
                'restoreAdminNormalized':True,'restoreAdminTrackedFootprintZero':True,'footprint':refs,
                'normalizedCatalogSha256':fingerprint(normalized),'catalogSha256':fingerprint(normalized),
                'countsSha256':sha(canonical(rc)),'ledgerPrefixSha256':normalized['prefix'],
                'network':'none','hostPorts':0,'hostMounts':0,'sourceCredentialsMounted':False,'imageId':IMAGE_ID,
                'databaseOwnerClassification':'LOCAL_RESTORE_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY',
                'databaseOwnerSourceFidelityClaim':False,'phaseResults':{k:'PASS' for k in ['E1','E2','E3','E3_RECONCILIATION','E4','E5','E6_DB_ACL','E7','E8']},
                'aclSupplementCount':len(supplement),
                'restoreExecutionContext':execution_context,'extensionValidation':extension_report,
                'databaseAclRecovery':database_report}
            result['phaseResults']['E6'] = 'PASS' if supplement else 'NOT_REQUIRED'
    # Cleanup must have actually completed before this result can be sealed.
    result.update(cleanup='OWNED_CONTAINER_REMOVED',ownedCleanup={'status':'PASS','ownedContainersRemaining':0})
    result['phaseResults']['E9'] = 'PASS'
    return result

measurementCoverage.guardIdentifierPolicy: For relation and column keys, rebuild unquoted concatenation from the existing structured source catalog relations/columns, mapping exact (schema,relation) owner to each (schema,relation,column). Each concatenated key must have exactly one tuple/owner mapping; reject collisions/unresolved rows. Do not parse role identifiers or infer column parent with rsplit. Other owner lookup uses unique exact (kind,ident) from this same source query, with ACL key coverage checked. Default ACL OID text stays same-source only.
measurementCoverage.queryResultFraming: Canonical JSON parsed by existing _Session abstraction; not raw protocol/stdout framing. No new claim rawResponseAvailable=true.
measurementCoverage.sourceGuardOmissions: No all-PostgreSQL-family or continuous execution identity claim. Unused refs CTE is not returned and supplies no membership/policy guard evidence. Existing separate role/membership/footprint gates remain mandatory.
measurementCoverage.transportExclusion: Only existing exact effective-query transport-name exclusion and verified roles-row removal. No filtering of typed owner, grantor, grantee, membership or policy references.

measurementCoverage.guardIdentifierPolicy: For relation and column keys, rebuild unquoted concatenation from the existing structured source catalog relations/columns, mapping exact (schema,relation) owner to each (schema,relation,column). Each concatenated key must have exactly one tuple/owner mapping; reject collisions/unresolved rows. Do not parse role identifiers or infer column parent with rsplit. Other owner lookup uses unique exact (kind,ident) from this same source query, with ACL key coverage checked. Default ACL OID text stays same-source only.
measurementCoverage.queryResultFraming: Canonical JSON parsed by existing _Session abstraction; not raw protocol/stdout framing. No new claim rawResponseAvailable=true.
measurementCoverage.sourceGuardOmissions: No all-PostgreSQL-family or continuous execution identity claim. Unused refs CTE is not returned and supplies no membership/policy guard evidence. Existing separate role/membership/footprint gates remain mandatory.
measurementCoverage.transportExclusion: Only existing exact effective-query transport-name exclusion and verified roles-row removal. No filtering of typed owner, grantor, grantee, membership or policy references.
